the respondent. 
IA No. 1 of 2024 
2. This is an Application seeking condonation of 
seven days’ delay in filing the instant First Appeal. 
3. For the reasons stated in the Application seeking
condonation of delay, the delay is condoned and the 
Application seeking condonation of delay is allowed. 
4. The marriage of the parties took place in the 
month on 25.01.2019 and they are living separately 
since 8th June, 2021. There is no child from the 
marriage. 
5. It is informed that the respondent is paying Rs. 
10,000/- per month as maintenance to the appellant. 
6. Learned counsel for the respondent will get 
instructions as to whether the respondent is ready to  pay Rs. 10 Lacs as the permanent alimony to the 
appellant. 
7. List this matter on 12.09.2024.
